text: Bitcoin is up modestly at $63,843 while Ethereum outpaces it with a 2.5% gain, suggesting some rotation toward altcoin utility despite the broader market trading in extreme fear. The Fear & Greed index at 23 indicates capitulation sentiment, yet the $64B daily volume and stable Bitcoin dominance at 56.3% show orderly selling rather than panic liquidation. This combination—fear with restrained volume and relative strength in Ethereum—typically precedes accumulation phases rather than further breakdown.
